title: Preserve the source environment during re-review lookup
problem: StamphogRepoConfig stores the canonical parent team ID. TaskRun.team_id keeps the source environment ID. The raw comparison returns None for valid child-environment runs. The caller also needs the source ID to find environment-scoped SignalReportArtefact rows. Initial reviews can succeed, but later pushes dismiss the approval without queueing a replacement.
suggestion: Compare resolve_effective_team_id(run.team_id) with the requested team ID. Add the source environment ID to SignalImplementationRunDTO and pass it to the reviewer resolver. Add a child-environment regression test.
